local: Ба бахти мо сари азизи ту баланд бод,
Саодати ту, давлати ту бегазанд бод.
english: Our beloved country,
Happy we are to see your dignity.
Let your joy and prosperity forever be.
We have reached this day since time immemorial.

local: Ба зери парчами ту саф кашидаем, кашидаем.
english: Together aligned we stand under your flag, under your flag.
Long live my homeland,
My free [[Tajikistan]]!
You are our symbol maternal,

local: Ту аз умеди рафтагони мо нишонаӣ,
Ки мазраи вафо бувад канори ту, канори ту.
english: You are the symbol of our honour and dignity,
You are for all your sons and daughters a world eternal,
Never shall your bosom fade away,
We shall continue to remain loyal to you, loyal to you.

local: Бақои ту бувад бақои хонадони мо,
english: Long live my homeland,
My free [[Tajikistan]]!
You are a mother for all of us,
Your destiny is the future for our families,

local: Мароми ту бувад мароми ҷисму ҷони мо,
Зи ту саодати абад насиби мост,
Ту ҳастиву ҳама ҷаҳон ҳабиби мост, ҳабиби мост.
english: Your meaning is the essence of our souls and bodies,
You give us amaranthine happiness,
Because of you, [[Tajikistan]], we love the world – love the world.
Long live my homeland,
My free [[Tajikistan]]!
